AND org = ? AND accepted = 1')` - a production read, reached only on workers binding AI and MOMENTS (learn-moment-index.js:243 guard; wrangler.parallel.jsonc:15-22).

@mentions: index.js:1101-1102 `const mentioned = await appForUser(env, user, name);` / `await appContext(env, mentioned, useSet)` read the production DB and RUNS. ask.jsx:392 offers other canvas-* names to a canvas chat (`!a.name.startsWith('repo-')`; the catalog includes canvases via dev-worker.js:44); appForUser queries the production apps table and returns null for them, so a canvas mention is dropped silently while its @chip stays in the message text (ask.jsx:441).

models-9.title: Refusal-fallback policy is implicit and differs by task for the same model id
evidence: The ask.js:306-307 comment reads 'an explicit model (chat picker or org setting) is incompatible with the server-side fallback feature - the API 400s on the combination'. ask.js:314 and :318 add `fallbacks: 'default'` and the beta header only when no model was chosen.

The code contradicts its own comment for claude-opus-5. The Auto body is `{ model: MODEL, fallbacks: 'default', ...body }` (ask.js:318), which sends model 'claude-opus-5' explicitly together with fallbacks (verifier probe), and this Auto path has answered dev Learn chat on the paid API since 2026-09-16 (coaching.md:1424). So the 'Opus 5' pick, the same id, loses the fallback for no demonstrated reason. The bundled API reference shows the same pairing (claude-api shared/model-migration.md:994-996).

Chat Auto and all grading get fallbacks 'default'. Explicit picks get none. Artifact and whiteboard on Anthropic pass an explicit 'claude-opus-5' (learn-artifact.js:51; learn-board.js:141), so they get none. Subscription sends `model || MODEL` without fallbacks (ask.js:283). The OpenAI branch has none.

Per model-migration.md:990 and :1417-1419, the `default` mode is a refusal fallback routed by category (cyber goes to claude-opus-4-8), not an availability fallback. The serving model shows in top-level `model` and as a `fallback_message` in usage.iterations. Routing is sticky for about an hour.
No Learn path handles `stop_reason: 'refusal'` explicitly: learn-research.js:29-42, learn-artifact.js:55, learn-board.js:156 (C8).
Whether sonnet-5 and haiku-4.5 accept fallbacks 'default' is unverified: model-migration.md:1415 requires targets in the model's allowed_fallback_models. It needs real calls.

Update doc section 9. Whether the explicit Opus 5 pick should also get the fallback is a separate decision for later.

lifecycle-4.snapshot_vs_baseline: Unchanged. ask.js, learn-research.js and learn-artifact.js have no diff, and learn-board.js changed only authorizedBoardApp. apiAsk gained the seam parameter but still passes no signal (baseline index.js:1227; snapshot index.js:1219).

A grep for 'signal' in control-plane/src and dev-worker.js finds only AbortSignal.timeout on tool, bridge, image, video and math fetches, plus Jev (learn-grade-jev.js:142); no req.signal anywhere.
packages/control-plane/src/ask.js:309-319 - the Anthropic fetch has no signal. planModel's OpenAI fetch (ask.js:264-268) has none either.

packages/control-plane/src/ask.js:364-461 - the answer runs in a floating `(async () => { ... })()` that writes to a TransformStream. It is not registered with ctx.waitUntil and has no cancel handling. index.js:344-346 and :364-366 record that platform limits already killed un-held model work in this codebase.
packages/control-plane/src/learn-research.js:16-22 - `for (let step = 0; step <= 8; step++)` never checks for cancellation. It only awaits onProgress writes (lines 37, 49, 52, 59, 62, 65, 67).

Verifier probe (read-only script in %TEMP%\lc-verify importing ask.js, global fetch stubbed): cancelling the reader after the first progress event gave {calls:2, finished:2, withSignal:1 (the arXiv tool fetch only), onDone:'not called'}. In-flight model and tool calls complete, the loop dies at its next write, and the answer is discarded while the user message stays stored (index.js:1209-1210; repositories.js:236).

New from the probe: `reader.cancel()` with no reason makes the next write reject with undefined, and ask.js:457 `await send('error', { error: e.message }).catch(() => {});` then throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'message')` inside the catch, which escapes the floating IIFE as an unhandled rejection. With a reason (cancel(new Error(...))) it does not. Which reason Workers passes on client disconnect is unverified.

packages/control-plane/src/learn-board.js:343-353 - the whiteboard stream's `cancel() { cancelled = true; }` only stops emits. generateBoardPlan keeps making every model call, so the 120 s client timeout (learn-board-request.js:25) never stops server work.
packages/control-plane/src/learn-artifact.js:51 - artifact model calls get no signal, and the client api() POST cannot be aborted (api.js:68).
Not verified: whether Cloudflare cancels the response stream, or the whole invocation, when the browser disconnects. wrangler configs set compatibility_date 2026-08-01 and no compatibility_flags.
lifecycle-4.smallest_change: After the reproduction, change the server only. In askStream, create one AbortController that aborts when the stream is cancelled (`writer.closed.catch(() => stop.abort())`). Pass its signal into researchAnswer, which checks `signal.aborted` before each step, and into the model call: anthropic() and planModel take an optional signal and hand it to fetch, and subscriptionTransport combines it with its 180 s timeout via AbortSignal.any. In boardFetch, abort the same way from the ReadableStream's cancel(). Make ask.js:457 read `e?.message` so a reason-less cancel cannot throw from the catch. Tool fetches keep their own 8-20 s timeouts. No request or event contract changes, and a stopped answer is still not stored, as today.
lifecycle-4.tests_to_add: Add packages/control-plane/test/ask-stream-cancel.test.js from the probe. Cancel the SSE reader after the first progress event and assert the in-flight model fetch received a signal that is now aborted, no further model or tool calls happen, onDone is not called, and no unhandledRejection fires when cancel() has no reason. researchAnswer with a pre-aborted signal makes no model call. boardFetch's cancel aborts the signal passed to generate. Platform reproduction is gated on deploy/model approval: on the session clone, ask a retrieval question on a canvas, press Stop after 'Finding papers...', then read that canvaschat thread in LEARN_DB. An assistant row means the loop finished after the disconnect; only the user row means it died at the next write. Pointing SUBSCRIPTION_ONLY's bridge (subscription-transport.js:4-6) at an HTTPS stub avoids real model calls.

paid-persist-14.title: Image, TTS and transcribe routes have no Origin check, so a same-site page (any *.zeroshothq.workers.dev host) can plausibly spend a signed-in learner's paid calls
evidence: packages/web/dev-worker.js:64 image `body = await req.json()`, :112 tts `body = await req.json()`, :131 transcribe `await req.formData()`. Workers parse the body regardless of Content-Type, so a text/plain JSON body or a multipart form is accepted. Both are CORS-simple requests that need no preflight.
None of the three checks Origin, whereas learn-video.js:25 (video, maths and scene via privateLessonAssetFetch) and learn-artifact.js:86 refuse a POST whose Origin differs from the worker's.

The session cookie is `SameSite=Lax` with no Domain (index.js:2328). Lax still sends the cookie on same-SITE cross-origin POSTs. The production worker and every dev clone share zeroshothq.workers.dev (wrangler.jsonc:35 BASE_URL https://small-cp.zeroshothq.workers.dev; CLAUDE.md clone names). workers.dev being on the Public Suffix List (so the site is zeroshothq.workers.dev) is an external fact not verifiable from this repo.

A same-site page that can run script exists: production serves teammates' deployed app HTML at /a/<org>/<app>/ with no CSP sandbox (index.js:2385-2417 passes response headers through; only run outputs get `sandbox allow-scripts` at index.js:2140-2142).

If reproduced, a page on that site can make a no-cors `fetch('https://small-cp-dev-<x>.zeroshothq.workers.dev/api/learn/image', {method:'POST', credentials:'include', body: JSON.stringify({app, prompt, confirmed:true})})`. authorizedBoardApp would pass with the victim's cookie, and paidRefusal would pass because the body sets confirmed. This shows again that confirmed: true is not proof of a click.
paid-persist-14.smallest_change: Add the existing one-line check to the three handlers before authorization: `if (req.headers.has('origin') && req.headers.get('origin') !== new URL(req.url).origin) return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid origin' }, { status: 403 });`. Same-origin api()/fetch calls from the Learn UI send their own origin and keep working. This adds no endpoint or schema. It does not cover app HTML served on the dev origin itself through the /a/ proxy, which is the platform's app-trust model and out of this cluster's scope.
paid-persist-14.snapshot_vs_baseline: Same at 3bc489e (the image, tts and transcribe handlers had no Origin check then either).
paid-persist-14.tests_to_add: If the handlers are moved into an importable module (paid-persist-3), a node test posting with `Origin: https://small-cp.zeroshothq.workers.dev` gets 403 before authorization and before any fetch. To reproduce first: signed in on the session clone, open a page on another zeroshothq.workers.dev host and issue the no-cors POST above with the provider stubbed or keyless (a 503 'not configured' reply still proves the request was authorized). 1. Repository path (no loader needed). Import { repositoriesFetch } from '../src/repositories.js', as repositories.test.js:5 does.
   - Start from the repositories.test.js env: SQLite LEARN_DB from repository-schema.sql, a REPOSITORY_SNAPSHOTS map, a canned CONTROL_PLANE.
   - Add DB: a D1-shaped fake whose prepare() records the SQL and whose run/first/all throw on INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or REPLACE; batch also throws.
   - Add RUNS, which records calls and throws on put or delete; LEARN_MEDIA as a recording Map; test-string EXA_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
   - Stub globalThis.fetch. api.anthropic.com returns a find_video_moments tool_use, then a show_video tool_use {videoId}, then text. api.exa.ai/search returns one youtube.com/watch?v=<id> hit. The youtubei player returns {} (no captions). Any other host throws.
   - POST ask {message:'show me a video'} and read the whole SSE text.
   - Assert: the DB record is empty, RUNS has no calls, the SSE video event has no momentId, and LEARN_DB holds 1 thread and 2 messages.
   - Assert on the recorded list, not on thrown errors. ask.js:400-407 and learn-moment-index.js:36-41, 52-58 and 243-253 swallow errors, so a throwing fake alone passes silently.
   - On the baseline this fails: DB records INSERT INTO learn_moments (reproduced; the verifier re-ran the trace). It passes after the repositories.js:237 seam.

2. Dev worker through its real fetch.
   - Plain node cannot import dev-worker.js (.html and .py imports; canvases.test.js:118 says so). index.js:22 has the same kind of import, which is why learn-chat.test.js:17-20 extracts function source and stubs askStream and findVideoMoments.
   - Fix: a module-customization hook that resolves .html and .py specifiers to `export default ''`, registered with node:module register() before `await import('../../web/dev-worker.js')`.
   - This works without touching package.json (npm test is node --test). It does not depend on the gitignored dist/ or dist-dev/.

3. Fakes for the dev-worker test.
   - LEARN_DB: SQLite.
   - DB: records every call and throws on writes. Allow only the SELECTs a scenario needs: hotMoment's learn_moments SELECT when AI and MOMENTS are bound, and @mention reads.
   - RUNS: records every call and throws on put or delete. Allow get and list only under bundles/ and runs/<id>/outputs/.
   - LEARN_MEDIA: a recording Map. It must be bound: dev-worker.js:37 returns 503 without it.
   - CONTROL_PLANE: canned. GET /api/apps returns {org, email, orgName, apps:[]}; GET /api/apps/<live> returns {name, org, email, kind:'server'}. Fail the test on any non-GET request or any other path; a proxied /api/learn/ask or /api/ask/threads/<n>/rename|delete is a live write.
   - Do not wire CONTROL_PLANE to the real live worker with a throwing DB: live GET /api/apps runs sweepStaleRuns (index.js:445-449).

4. Matrix, built from the exact client shapes (ask.jsx:495-518, ask-stream.js:10-18, learn-grade.js:15-18):
   - canvas-<8hex>, and a canvas row with project=repo-*: ask, follow-up with thread_id, show_video follow-up, multipart (expect 400), History list, open, rename and delete on the /api/ask/threads paths (ask.jsx:415, 404, 681, 660).
   - repo-*: ask, follow-up, show_video, multipart under and over 64 KB (expect 413 for the large one), History with GET, PATCH and DELETE on /api/repositories/<app>/threads (ask.jsx:326-331).
   - live app: JSON and multipart asks (expect 403 after the fix).
   - text/plain POST /api/learn/ask (expect 415 after the fix).
   - Expected after the fixes: no DB writes, no RUNS writes, no non-GET CONTROL_PLANE calls, rows only in LEARN_DB, and every SSE ends in done or a JSON error.
   - Keep the source pins green: canvases.test.js:119-126 and learn-research.test.js:48-53 (exact text `if (['/api/learn/selection', '/api/learn/ask'].includes(path)` and the line 108 seam ternary).

5. Current state. Verified by the verifier: node --test canvases.test.js, learn-chat.test.js and repositories.test.js pass 70/70 on the baseline.

The verifier ran C:\Users\cyudhist\AppData\Local\Temp\c1-devworker-e2e.mjs and it worked, with no dependency and no warning.

- LEARN_DB: node:sqlite from repository-schema.sql, plus the learn_moments DDL once agreed.
- DB: the spy.
- RUNS: throws.
- LEARN_MEDIA: a Map.
- CONTROL_PLANE: GET-only fake for /api/apps and /api/apps/<name>.

T6-boards-media.test_plan:
Existing tests pass on the baseline: node --test on learn-boards, learn-storage, learn-feedback, canvases, learn-media, learn-paper, learn-video and learn-scene .test.js ran 50 tests, 50 passed (re-run by the verifier). The original agent's probe (DB and RUNS throwing, CONTROL_PLANE fake throwing on non-GET) proves the dev handlers never write DB or RUNS directly and never send a non-GET to production. It cannot prove 'no production write through the proxy': the fake replaces production's GET /api/apps handler, which in reality runs sweepStaleRuns (index.js:449). State that limit in the test comment.

To make this permanent (packages/control-plane/test, node:test):

(1) Fakes. Use learnDb(t) from test/learn-grade-fixture.js:7-24 for LEARN_DB. repository-schema.sql already has canvases (line 27), so the manual CREATE at learn-boards.test.js:14 is redundant. Take the throwing DB from canvases.test.js:29. Take the throwing RUNS from learn-storage.test.js:40, the `live` object. Use an in-memory LEARN_MEDIA with put, get (body, arrayBuffer, json, httpMetadata, customMetadata) and list (objects, truncated). Use a CONTROL_PLANE fake that records method and path, returns JSON for GET /api/apps and GET /api/apps/<project app>, and throws on any non-GET.

(2) Change learn-boards.test.js:27-33 to pass the bucket as LEARN_MEDIA plus a throwing RUNS. Today it names the fake RUNS, so it exercises the production fallback, not dev. Do the same for learn-media.test.js:34-64. Add a project-app, a repo- and a canvas- case to the board save/share/assets/fork tests.

(3) Durable Objects. Construct new LearnVideos(state, env) and new LearnScenes(state, env) directly as learn-video.test.js:43-46 and learn-scene.test.js:29-32 do, but with LEARN_MEDIA plus a throwing RUNS. POST a confirmed job, run alarm(), assert the clip or GLB landed in LEARN_MEDIA under learn-video-dev/ or learn-scene-dev/. If the optional hardening is adopted, add a case without LEARN_MEDIA that asserts refusal and no RUNS call.

(4) Production side effect of the identity read: characterize it in a production-worker test (import index.js default fetch with a recording DB fake and a session header) asserting that GET /api/apps issues the sweepStaleRuns UPDATE and GET /api/apps/<name> issues none. This documents current behavior; any change to it is the separate decision.

(5) dev-worker.js is not importable under plain node (it imports ./dist-dev/index.html and ../byoc/*.py; the rules live in tested modules such as canvases.js:37 canvasRoute). To test routing end to end, register a load hook with node:module registerHooks mapping .html and .py to `export default <JSON string>` (stub dist-dev/index.html via a resolve hook if absent), then call the default export's fetch with fake LEARN_VIDEOS and LEARN_SCENES namespaces. Assert: 503 with no LEARN_MEDIA; every board and media route with the throwing DB, RUNS and non-GET CONTROL_PLANE fakes; decide whether non-GET unmatched /api/learn/* paths should keep falling through to production (404, no write) or be refused.

(6) Keep learn-storage.test.js:17-37, which guards the config and source text.

No wrangler, D1, R2 or model calls are needed for any of this.
T6-boards-media.notes:
Verdict for this focus: C1's content invariant holds on baseline feb4825 for board sharing, uploads, feedback and generated media. None of the three canvas kinds, nor the /b/<token> view or fork, writes Learn conversations, grades, moments or assets to production DB or small-runs. Rows go to LEARN_DB (small-learn-dev: learn_boards, canvases). Files go to LEARN_MEDIA (small-learn-media-dev). Durable Object state lives on the dev worker.

Correction: production is NOT only read. Every authorization that goes through repositoryIdentity (canvas-<hex>, repo-<slug>, non-public shared view, fork, sidebar feedback, the dev app list) calls production GET /api/apps, whose handler apiApps starts with `await sweepStaleRuns(env);` (index.js:449) = `UPDATE runs SET status = 'failed' WHERE status = 'running' AND started_at < datetime('now','-6 hours')` (index.js:445-446) on production D1 small. It is pre-existing, global, idempotent housekeeping that every production dashboard list also performs, and it is not Learn data, but it is a production write triggered by dev Learn requests. The project-app path uses GET /api/apps/<name> (apiAppGet), which is read-only. Removing the sweep side effect needs either a production behavior change or a new read-only identity contract: separate decision.

Classification against the architecture doc:
- Section 14 claims (learn_boards in LEARN_DB; learnMedia is LEARN_MEDIA on dev and RUNS otherwise; board assets under learn-boards/; /b/<token> view and fork): still present and accurate.
- Section 14's LEARN_DB table list omits canvases. The fork INSERT into canvases already existed at 3bc489e (3bc489e:packages/control-plane/src/learn-boards.js:156), but the canvases table did not exist in 3bc489e's repository-schema.sql; the baseline adds it (repository-schema.sql:27). Doc omission: still present.
- Branch-specific: the canvas branch in authorizedBoardApp at learn-board.js:368-371 (the only diff to learn-board.js since 3bc489e; learn-boards.js, learn-video.js, learn-scene.js, learn-feedback.js, learn-media.js, learn-paper.js and learn-storage.js are unchanged). At 3bc489e paper/media/feedback/video/scene for a canvas-<hex> name were proxied to production /api/apps/<name> (404); boards already worked via boardOwner.
- Branch-specific: LearnPage is no longer mounted for a normal app on any build (3bc489e:packages/web/src/SharePage.jsx:608-610 mounted it; baseline imports LearnPage only from CanvasPage.jsx:7 and RepositoryPage.jsx:5).
- Nuance on 'a board is saved only when shared': POST /share on a never-saved board inserts a row even with shared:false (learn-boards.js:108-111).
- Stale doc: canvas-sharing.md:53 says small-runs. Doc-only fix.

Residual risks in this focus:
(a) Defense-in-depth: LearnVideos and LearnScenes alarms use learnMedia(this.env) outside the dev-worker.js:37 guard; safe today because both configs bind LEARN_MEDIA (asserted by learn-storage.test.js:17-27).
(b) Tests name the in-memory bucket RUNS (learn-boards, learn-media, learn-video, learn-scene), so they exercise the production fallback; rebind as LEARN_MEDIA with a throwing RUNS.
(c) Fork has no duplicate protection; dev-only storage.
(d) GET /api/apps sweep side effect (above).

AND org = ?` on env.DB = production D1 small, then SELECTs and upserts Vectorize. No seam. For canvases the moment INSERT (ask.js:404) goes to LEARN_DB via the seam (index.js:1225-1227; LEARN_DB has no learn_moments table), yet the UPDATE still executes against production.
